findings.issue: Invented topic: 'As for this' mirrors nothing in the JP (no これは/それは). Also the particle tags are swapped: (の) is placed after 'second-year students' and (が) after 'junior high', but the JP is 中学校の + ２年生が, so の belongs to 'junior high' and が to 'students'.
findings.current: As for this, the second-year students (の) of junior high (が) the workplace experience (を) did.
findings.suggested: Of the junior high (の), the second-year students (が) the workplace experience (を) did.

findings.issue: Same defect as lit_en: 'Quanto a (isto)' invents a topic absent from the JP, and the (の)/(が) tags are swapped relative to 中学校の２年生が — の is attached to 'alunos do segundo ano' and が to 'colégio ginasial', the reverse of the Japanese.
findings.current: Quanto a (isto), os alunos do segundo ano (の) do colégio ginasial (が) a experiência de local de trabalho (を) fizeram.
findings.suggested: Do colégio ginasial (の), os alunos do segundo ano (が) a experiência de local de trabalho (を) fizeram.

findings.issue: 宿題 means 'homework', not 'lesson'. The main en translation and the token gloss both correctly say homework/assignment, so 'the lesson' in lit_en is an inaccurate mirror that suggests a class lesson.
findings.current: As for the lesson, if I don't do it, I get scolded by the teacher.
findings.suggested: As for the homework, if I don't do it, I get scolded by the teacher.

findings.issue: Missing sentence-final period; every other lit_pt in the batch ends with '.'.
findings.current: Quanto à lição, se não a fizer, pelo professor sou bronqueado
findings.suggested: Quanto à lição, se não a fizer, pelo professor sou bronqueado.

findings.issue: Trailing sentence 'Everything is well-formed and natural.' is a QA/validator verdict about the sentence, not learner-facing structural explanation; it leaks the generation pipeline and should be deleted.
Trailing 'Tudo está bem formado e natural.' is the same leaked QA verdict as in expl_en, not explanation content for learners; delete.
findings.current: Tudo está bem formado e natural.

findings.issue: Trailing 'A well-formed and natural sentence.' is a QA/validator verdict leaked into the learner-facing explanation; delete.
Trailing 'Frase bem formada e natural.' is the same leaked QA verdict as in expl_en; delete.

いろんな means 'various / all kinds of' (as lit_en 'Various people' and both explanations correctly teach); 'Many people' renders quantity instead of variety, contradicting the sentence's stated vocabulary focus.
findings.suggested: All kinds of people do research.
